timeline-digest-tool-free v1.0.0

- Initial public release of the free timeline digest tool for X/Twitter.
- Fetches "For You" and "Following" timelines via CLI commands and processes tweets with incremental filtering to avoid duplicates.
- Applies hard (ID-based) and approximate (text similarity) deduplication, basic heuristic filtering (ads/spam), and outputs structured JSON digests for personal news aggregation.
- Designed for individual users needing quick, low-noise summaries; no scheduled execution or advanced classification (see PRO version for more).
- Includes side-by-side feature comparison of Free vs. PRO version in documentation.
